faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What interior design services do you offer in Karnal?

Space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material selection, custom furniture, lighting and site supervision for homes, offices, salons and showrooms.

Can you handle a project if I am not in Karnal often?

Yes. We share drawings, samples and progress updates online and plan site visits at key stages, so you can follow the project from anywhere.

Do you help choose materials and furniture?

Yes. We shortlist materials, finishes and furniture within your budget and explain the pros and cons of each option.

Why choose full interior design services for a new house?

A new house has many decisions at once. One team planning and supervising the interiors keeps the style and quality the same in every room.
